profile.Name: Lady Kana
profile.Personality: Maniacal, vain, and gleefully cruel. She mocks visitors and slaves alike, holds that some people are born to be slaves, and calls her farm the biggest in the outlands.
profile.Backstory: Owner of the slave farm at Port North. A Traders Guild noble and a key associate of the Slave Traders. She lounges in her noble house at the Port North slave farm, guarded by hooded noble guards and samurai, and boasts that the clothes people wear are made by her slaves.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Pompous and mocking, with a gloating 'Mmmhaha'. She calls visitors 'unbathed one', likens slaves to brainless cattle, and shrieks threats when crossed ('A NOBLE NEVER FORGETS!').
